policy.pool: anchor plus all newly fixed attack candidates under common fullBG; no baseline duplicate/control/historical comparator
policy.secondary_oracle_pool: all saved common-fullBG roles including controls and historical comparators; descriptive only
policy.tie: anchor priority, then registry family order, then method lexical order
policy.bootstrap_interpretation: descriptive 2.5/97.5 percentiles, not p-values or independent generalization CI; do not refit method choice
